stock.description: JBB Builders International Limited functions as an engineering contractor, providing a comprehensive range of marine construction, building, and infrastructure solutions to developers and other contractors throughout Malaysia and Singapore. Its marine construction expertise spans detailed land reclamation initiatives, including preliminary soil investigations, hydrographic surveys, and design work prior to reclamation, as well as sand handling, ground treatment, and the removal of sand surcharge. The company also executes various marine civil engineering projects, such as constructing jetties, developing channel-crossing facilities, performing maintenance dredging, and orchestrating river diversion works. Furthermore, JBB Builders manages marine sand logistics, encompassing the loading of sand from approved sources onto carriers, its transportation, and delivery for offloading at specific sites intended for land reclamation. In addition to its marine sector focus, the firm delivers building and infrastructure services, which include general property construction and other infrastructure developments. The company is also engaged in the production and trading of sand, alongside offering land-based machinery services and equipment rental. Established in 2012, JBB Builders International Limited is headquartered in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
